prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1267; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in your file. Our client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision and is entitled to a full and fair evaluation of the claim. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this file so that our correspondence can be properly referenced.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair or total loss estimates, and any telematics or dashcam footage in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until the claim is fully resolved.
